question: What was the main aim of IRDP (Integrated Rural Development Programme) ?

options.text: To provide free food to rural families
To assist poor rural families in acquiring assets or skills for self-employment

solution:
The Correct answer is __**To assist poor rural families in acquiring assets or skills for self-employment.**__

• The **Integrated Rural Development Programme (IRDP)** was launched in **1978-79** and extended throughout India by **1980.**
